# Chronosport

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: chronosport
Class: provenance_first_sports_history_and_fair_play_archive
Canonical URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/products/chronosport
Authority: public read-only exploration of a versioned sports history graph and source registry
Human confirmation required: no

## Natural-language intents
- research sports history with sources
- find a historical sports event
- trace teams athletes seasons venues and results
- study how sports rules changed over time
- audit the source trail behind a sports result
- explore fair play or officiating evidence without unsupported accusations

## Boundaries
- historical facts, corrections and rule eras remain versioned rather than silently overwritten
- fair-play anomalies trigger review and must not be presented as proof of wrongdoing
- source limitations and unresolved historical questions should remain visible
- private account or editorial administration data is outside public discovery

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
